title: Singapore dollar to Thai baht, daily since 1981
description: Baht per Singapore dollar and Singapore dollars per 1,000 baht, each working day since 1981: MAS's noon rate where MAS publishes one, and earlier days from the source named on each row.
question: What is the Singapore dollar worth in baht, on any working day since 1981?

fields.name: date
fields.meaning: The day the rate is for.

fields.name: thb_per_sgd
fields.meaning: How many baht one Singapore dollar buys (the inverse of the next column, kept to six decimals).

fields.name: sgd_per_1000_thb
fields.meaning: Singapore dollars per 1,000 baht, the way MAS quotes it.

fields.name: source
fields.meaning: Which figure the row is: FED-H10 = the US Federal Reserve's H.10 noon rates, crossed (before MAS's daily record); MAS = MAS, as of noon.
